latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Investment Browser SEC Scraper:

- Parses 10-Q/10-K SEC EDGAR filings for 47 key financial metrics.
- Extracts Revenue, Net Income, Free Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, and MD&A risk factors.
- Automatically calculates YoY growth, margins, current ratios, and debt-to-equity.
- Exports data to CSV, HTML, PDF, and Markdown formats.
- Designed for professional and institutional investors tracking SEC filings.
